market.question: Will the highest temperature in Tokyo be 21°C or higher on May 1?

assessment.reasoning: Tokyo Haneda May 1 climatological high averages ~21°C with early-May highs typically 20-22°C. AccuWeather monthly range for May has highs spanning 17-27°C. With the threshold sitting right at the average, probability of high being 21°C or above is roughly coin-flip, slight lean to yes given typical first-week pattern.
data_sources: agatetravel/umetravel Tokyo May early-month avg high ~20.9°C
assessment.key_uncertainty: Cool front passage on May 1 specifically would push high below 21°C; no specific high-fidelity day-of forecast located.
